versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Figma Spacing System skill.
- Generates a full spacing token scale, responsive grid definitions, component spacing conventions, and step-by-step Figma implementation guide.
- Ensures all spacing values are multiples of a chosen base unit and supports custom platform/grid/density inputs.
- Includes anti-patterns and quality checks to promote robust, scalable, and consistent design systems.
- Output suitable for Figma and direct engineering handoff.
